name: A Faded Journal Page
summary: In eastern Elwynn, an old page points toward Stalvan Mistmantle's grim history.

sections.title: Parchment in the Chest
sections.body: The Faded Journal Page lay for years in an old trunk at Marshal Haggard's home near Elwynn Forest's eastern border. Haggard had retired there, but his failing eyesight kept him from reading the weathered parchment. The page stayed neglected until investigators seeking the truth about Stalvan Mistmantle retrieved it.

sections.title: The Trail to Darkshire
sections.body: Marshal Haggard could not read the brittle writing, but he sent investigators across the river to the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Duskwood. Tavernkeep Smitts, the barkeep, recognized the handwriting as soon as he examined the page, tying it to the grim saga that haunts the region.

faq.q: Where is the Faded Journal Page found?
faq.answer: The page is found in an upstairs chest in a house near Marshal Haggard, in eastern Elwynn Forest by the river boundary with Duskwood.

faq.q: Why couldn't Marshal Haggard read the page himself?
faq.answer: Marshal Haggard's eyesight has grown so poor with age that he can no longer make out the faded writing.

faq.q: Who recognizes the handwriting on the journal page?
faq.answer: Tavernkeep Smitts, the barkeep at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, recognizes the handwriting when he sees the page.

faq.q: What protects the chest containing the page?
faq.answer: A hostile Forlorn Spirit attacks anyone who opens the upstairs chest, before the page can be examined safely.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, this forgotten record can help solve a mystery that has troubled townsfolk on both sides of the river between Elwynn and Duskwood.
